subject.mother: A large, sleek mother Stenopterygius, detailed with soft grey-blue countershading and a friendly, watchful amber eye.
subject.pup: A tiny, matching Ichthyosaur pup, designed in a classic 'chibi' toy style, swimming close under her pectoral fin.

layer_3_action.action: The mother Stenopterygius is swimming gracefully horizontally, her head slightly turned to look back at the tiny pup mimicking her movements.

companions.description: A distant, hazy school of small squid-like Belemnites, blurred to create depth.
A single floating driftwood log covered in stylized, golden-pyrite crinoid 'sea lilies' in the upper far background.

text_overlay.style: Bright red, 3D extruded clay-style lettering, mixed case, playful sans-serif font.
Bright red, 3D extruded clay-style lettering, mixed case, playful sans-serif font.

visual_logic.water: Dark indigo water with distinct shimmering vertical 'god-rays' filtering from the surface, creating an atmospheric, deep-shelf effect.
visual_logic.atmosphere: Abundant suspended organic particulates ('marine snow') shimmering with soft light.
